text: ok how about in the studio a preview button that will show the player model on the mesh depending on the rigging
resolution: Built the Studio seat-preview the user asked for: a 'preview seats' toggle (appears beside the scale-ghost button once at least one face is rigged) places the player model on the mesh exactly where the seat rig puts it — sit or lay per the tagged head, one occupant per derived pin (a booth shows several side by side, a bed shows figures lying down), facing derived from the back/head faces. It updates live as you tag faces and the button shows the capacity (xN). Implementation reuses the viewport's existing scale-ghost figure infra (FigureMeshes + CharacterCaptures) and the SAME derivation the cook runs — I extracted riggedFacesFor() in cookedAsset.ts so the cook and the preview share one resolver and the preview can never drift from what Compile bakes. Whole hmsc-int cart bundles clean (exit 0); cook 26/26 holds. The live look is the user's to confirm in rjit dev.
